unitAttributionChecks.zh: 如駕或東幸，廟仍虛主，即准肅宗廣德二年上都作主故事，特作闕主而祔。
unitAttributionChecks.reason: 肅宗 names Suzong (p008). 廣德二年 is Guangde 2 of the Tang calendar under Emperor Daizong (p009); adding p009 at this unit is chronology-consistent and does not invent Western years.

unitAttributionChecks.reason: 成王 in the witness supports King Cheng (p073 personal-name) in addition to existing posthumous-name surfaces on p050; no new dating claim.

unitAttributionChecks.zh: 京兆少尹韋武議曰：「凡三年一祫，五年一禘。
unitAttributionChecks.reason: Named speaker is 韋武 (Wei Wu, p208). 京兆少尹 is the Tang capital-district vice-governor office; p175 is Sima Fang (司馬防), cited elsewhere only as a historical 京兆 figure (s0572), not this office or witness.

personChecks.reason: Era 廣德 ties to Daizong reign without altering Chinese calendar text.
成王 token supports King Cheng personal-name record; redundant with p050 but source-backed.
Title-reference Jingzhao at s0672 conflates office toponym with unrelated Jin-dynasty Sima Fang record.
韋武 remains the sole named person in the witness.

priorChecksOnHold.reason: Until s0672 drops p175 or owner supplies source-grounded link between 京兆少尹 and Sima Fang, chapter chronology approval for this delta scope remains blocked.

remainingDiscrepancies.detail: 京兆少尹韋武 names Wei Wu only; generic 京兆 office does not identify 司馬防 (p175).
